targetBoundary: Task target and task success are separate fields. The actual receiver action scores prediction; target-action probability is used only for LV-L.

nativePredictor.source: authenticated training-only hypothesis.created, hypothesis.revised, or hypothesis.contradicted ledger event
nativePredictor.selection: Latest verified ledger sequence before cutoff for receiver and token
nativePredictor.value: associationOverTypeCodes normalized over the current four candidates after adding 1e-12 to each nonnegative weight

predictors.fit: Laplace-smoothed actual action positions conditional on delivered token only
Laplace-smoothed token/type counts using ordinary records

predictors.features: bias, token one-hot, candidate type one-hot, position one-hot, token/type interaction
predictors.fit: 2000 full-batch gradient steps, learning rate 0.05, L2 penalty 0.01 excluding bias, zero initialization
frozen recurrent receiver forward pass with checkpoint hidden state, delivered token, candidate observation and temperature 1; no state advance

ordinaryRecordWindow.selection: lowest realized multiclass Brier on validation-selection; tie tolerance 1e-12 and predictor list order
ordinaryRecordWindow.refit: chosen model refits using training, validation-fit and validation-selection records before test prediction

score.name: multiclass-brier/v1
score.formula: sum over ordered candidates of (probability - one-hot actual action)^2
score.expectedExcessReplayFormula: sum over ordered candidates of (nativeProbability - exactReplayProbability)^2

family.memberProcedure: LV-C p-value is its maximum component p-value; Holm adjusts LV-P, LV-C and LV-L in that order for exact ties.

components.statistic: negative mean normal-case expected excess replay Brier
exact replay target-action probability under ledger-consistent minus ledger-shuffled message

family.unit: independently trained dyad; average within receiver role then equally across roles
family.test: one-sided seed-level Student t test of mean statistic greater than boundary
family.zeroSdRule: Return p=1 with flagged degenerate interval; do not divide by zero.
family.intervals: marginal two-sided 95% seed-level t intervals plus simultaneous one-sided component bounds at alpha 0.05/6
family.sensitivity: 10000-resample deterministic seed bootstrap is descriptive only
family.invaliditySensitivity: Report valid-only inference and descriptive worst-admissible-value bounds across every attempted dyad.

interpretation.LV-P: A rejected null supports fidelity within 0.02 expected excess Brier in this registered setting, not additional information beyond complete policy state.
interpretation.LV-C: A rejected null supports all four registered normal-minus-control margins in this setting.
interpretation.LV-L: A rejected null supports the registered local target-action probability contrast, not human-like semantics or subjective intention.
interpretation.nonRejection: Report not supported at the registered threshold; do not assert equivalence or no effect.
interpretation.ordinaryRecords: All ordinary-record comparisons are descriptive, including a comparator that matches or beats the ledger.

claimBoundary: This is a fixed analysis plan, not a pilot result, selected N, resource authorization or finding.
